mechanism: Esomeprazole reduces gastric acid, which may impair zoledronic acid absorption if given orally, and chronic PPI use is associated with increased risk of bisphosphonate-related osteonecrosis of the jaw (BRONJ) and atypical fractures due to altered mineral metabolism.
action: Monitor for signs of BRONJ and atypical fractures; ensure adequate calcium and vitamin D supplementation; consider PPI deprescribing if clinically feasible; maintain dental hygiene and avoid invasive dental procedures when possible.
